description.narrative: The request for deployment is part of UNHCR Chad’s emergency response to the ongoing cholera outbreak. This support is intended to reinforce immediate operational capacity during the critical phase of the response. Once the emergency response mechanisms are fully established and stabilised, UNHCR Chad will transition to relying on its existing water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) staff to sustain and manage regular operations.Under the supervision of the Head of Field Office in Farchana, the WASH Officer will:• Coordinate with partners interventions in the camps and in the host communities, for synchronised response to address identified WASH needs; • Participate in WASH coordination meetings as well as in technical monitoring of activities;• Support the community engagement approach through capacity building of water and sanitation committees in close collaboration with local authorities;• Provide assessments, designs, and ensure the implementation of potable water supply system for entry points, existing camps, and new camps in relation to the emergency response;• Technical support to existing projects focused on surface water management and hydro-agricultural infrastructure development for refugee and local community;• Contribute to preparation of donor report and any other update/reports as required;• Contribute to development of proposals/concept notes related to WASH based on identified needs in coordination with WASH country team and reporting section;• Perform other relevant duties as required.
